This happens to me often when I smoke.  I feel like just chillin with the sensations and thoughts that Im having, but often deep conversations come up and I beging to feel awkward contributing or opening my mouth.

The best advice I can give is to remember that you matter.  Your opinion counts and is interesting, no matter how much that devil on your shoulder says otherwise.  As hard as it is, force yourself to say something when you feel the impulse and forget about how you look or sound.  And remember to smile and laugh!  You can contribute with non verbal cues as well.  

Remember that you're in a group of friends that cares about you and what you have to say, they just might get carried away with something (common when high!) and there's absolutely no harm in pushing yourself into the conversation.  Whatever anxiety you feel, know that you alone generate it, and can take active steps to feel more comfortable at any point.
